title: Half-percent general excise tax surcharge
summary: In March 2026, officials said a reimbursement will be paid from the general excise tax (GET) surcharge account. Bill 38, discussed in March 2025, lets surcharge money for water projects go to the water department, be tracked separately and be returned when the project ends. The Council created the surcharge in 2023 after heated testimony, with an end date of December 31, 2030, and a 20% set-aside for Hawaiian homestead development.

timeline.text: The vice chair asked the department for estimates of what the GET surcharge could cover.
timeline.body: County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee

timeline.text: The vice chair said a half-percent GET surcharge could pay for water and sewer infrastructure for housing.

timeline.text: He said he will look into whether a proposed half-percent tax could help pay for cesspool conversion.
